biggest_catch: AUDIT CORRECTION 2026-09-23: withdrawn from verified. Official dscout terms confirm per-mission pay is disclosed upfront and paid via PayPal on completion, but no official dscout page states a concrete payment arrival time — 'within days / 5-10 business days' claims came from third-party guides. Per-mission pay ranges ($10-$150) also came from third-party sources.
catches: Official: mission-specific pay shown upfront; paid on completion via PayPal.
Pay ranges cited by third-party guides, not dscout.
Missions are competitive; applying does not mean selection.
Quality bar: poor submissions can be rejected with no pay.

c1.evidence: Official dscout Scout Terms (pactsafe): 'Each Mission will have its own set of terms as to payment, if any, for participation. Scouts are paid only upon completion of the Mission to the specifications provided by the Researcher.' Official app listing: 'Get paid via PayPal once the study is complete. Payments are clearly listed upfront.'

c2.evidence: Per-mission pay is disclosed upfront per mission (official), but no concrete universal pay table exists in official material; ranges quoted from third-party guides.

c3.evidence: Free to join as a scout; no fees in official terms.

c4.evidence: No official dscout page states concrete payment arrival timing — third-party '5-10 business days' claims are not provider material.

eligibility: 18+; smartphone or computer with camera/mic; US primarily; Welcome Mission unlocks Express missions.
maximize: No playbook — rejected: no official payment-arrival timing. If dscout ever publishes official timing within 7 days, the repeat loop is per-mission tasks (Express missions first) with pay stated upfront in each mission.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23; corrected from verify to reject in audit. dscout is a legitimate high-pay research panel and its upfront per-mission pay disclosure is honest, but the lane's hard rule requires concrete timing from official provider material, which dscout does not publish.
